_comment: Candidates the scout has already put forward and that were judged not
worth a template. It re-ranks the same catalogue every Monday and the
scores barely move, so without this it proposes the same shortlist for
ever and the report stops being read — which is the one failure a scout
A line here is a decision somebody made, and removing one is how a
candidate gets a second hearing: say so in the commit that does it. The
scout says how many it skipped, so this list cannot quietly swallow the
The key is the scout's own slug: the catalogue name lowercased with every
run of non-alphanumerics turned into a hyphen. "Dify.ai" is dify-ai, not
dify. A key that matches nothing is reported rather than ignored, because a
typo here would make this whole list a no-op that looks like it is working.

dify-ai.why: the fleet already ships dify-traefik-letsencrypt-docker-compose, released v1.0.3 on 2026-09-18; a second template would duplicate it rather than add anything

hoppscotch-community-edition.why: no state worth backing up, and self-hosting an API client for one person is a thin justification for a permanent template

stirling-pdf.why: stateless in practice, so the backup, restore and upgrade-on-same-volumes half of this fleet's contract would be vacuous

code-server.why: a browser IDE is a terminal on the host's Docker network with a password in front of it; a one-command template for strangers makes that the default, and the compose itself is one container, a volume and Traefik, which the fleet already shows a dozen times

appflowy.why: the catalogue's AGPL-3.0 is the client's: the open server, AppFlowy-IO/AppFlowy-Cloud, was archived after 2026-09-11, and self-hosting now goes through AppFlowy-SelfHost-Commercial under a commercial licence whose free tier is one user seat per instance, which is not a licence this fleet can hand to strangers

caddy.why: a reverse proxy, not a service: every template already ships its ingress as Traefik, and Caddy's only state is a certificate cache Let's Encrypt reissues, so there is nothing for a backup, a restore drill or an upgrade on the same volumes to prove
